Validates that all user guide steps work exactly as documented. Requires: operator deployed, namespace labelled, S3 fixtures uploaded.
Run all: robot --outputdir results tests/ Run one: robot --outputdir results tests/01_quick_start.robot Smoke: robot --outputdir results -i smoke tests/
